notes.title: Hanctt Origins 1.1 Update & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]Hanctt Origins - Update 1.1 Patch Notes[/b]

[list]
[*] Sensitivity settings have been fixed.
[*] Visual bug in the HUD has been fixed.
[*] A number of visual bugs have been fixed and improved.
[*] New sound effects have been added and some existing sounds have been updated.
[*] The character's walking sensation has been made smoother.
[*] Statistics such as health and armor were not reloaded at each level.
[*] Bugs related to recoil and camera shake have been fixed.
[*] Some optimization improvements have been made. However, additional improvements that will further improve performance will be available with the upcoming Act 2 update.
[/list]

Your feedback is important to us! Enjoy the game!

notes.title: v1.0 FULL Version OUT NOW! 🥳
notes.notes:
[h2][b]New Features and Updates[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Merchant System[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Encounter merchants every few levels.
[*] [b]Purchases:[/b] Buy bullets, medkits, and armor.
[*] [b]Weapons:[/b] Discover new weapons in their inventory.
[*] [b]Sell Items:[/b] Trade valuable items for Ichor, the rare currency of the Hanctt District.
[/list]

[h3][b]Gab’s Outfit Evolution[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Evolve Gab’s uniforms for unique perks:
[*] [b]Perks:[/b] Run faster, gain 5 seconds of immortality, and more!
[*] [b]Balance Your Skills:[/b] Don’t spend all your skill points on weapons—Gab deserves some attention too!
[/list]

[h3][b]New Weapons[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]E-S16:[/b] A fast and reliable close-range pistol.
[*] [b]Gaze:[/b] Take down enemies from long distances with precision.
[*] [b]Cultist's Fury:[/b] A high-rate-of-fire machine gun.
[*] [b]Dual Cultist's Fury:[/b] Unleash chaos with dual machine guns!
[*] [b]Dagon's Fang:[/b] Slash your enemies.
[/list]

[h3][b]New Levels[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Continue Gab’s journey across the Hanctt Continent with 30 new levels.
[*] [b]Explore New Regions:[/b] Battle through Modkefn, Swojkord, Ludtern, and Insmouth in search of Lina.
[/list]

[h3][b]Optimization Settings[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]FSR Support:[/b] FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) added to graphics options.
[*] FPS drops are minimized for a smoother gameplay experience.
[/list]

[h3][b]New Menus and Gameplay Mechanics[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]ACT Menu:[/b] Replay your favorite levels anytime.
[*] [b]TAB Menu:[/b] Upgrade your weapons during gameplay. Remember, you need to visit the merchant to upgrade!
[*] [b]New Objective Menu:[/b] Track your goals and manage missions with ease.
[*] [b]Change Difficulty Menu:[/b] Adjust the difficulty whenever you like.
[/list]

[h3][b]New Enemy Types[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Face enemies specifically designed for the new regions, making battles more challenging and diverse.
[/list]

[h1][b]Full Version and What’s Next[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191573/28dc776c5397ead6a6bf7f782f02e8b6422e6820.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Act I Complete:[/b] The full version of Hanctt Origins is now live!
[*] [b]Act II & New Hero:[/b] In future updates, explore the remote areas of the Hanctt Continent with Captain Elara. Prepare for new gameplay mechanics and thrilling adventures!
[/list]

[h2][b]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Performance issues resolved.
[*] Graphics and optimization tweaks applied.
[*] Various minor bug fixes completed.
[/list]

Prepare yourself for the [b]full Hanctt Origins experience![/b] Good luck on Gab’s quest to find Lina.
Spend your Ichor wisely, [b]upgrade your gear[/b], and uncover the secrets of the [b]Hanctt Continent![/b]
